card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The first digit inside a parenthesized section number in cross-references such as "[see Use in Specific Populations (8.1)]". It is strongest on 8, and also fires on 7 and 1 there.

modes.label: Cross-reference digit
modes.description: The opening digit of a section number after "see ... (" in a drug label.

modes.label: Parenthesized number after a sentence
modes.description: A section number in parentheses right after a sentence about interactions.
